messages:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy smoke summary for rollout r-2026-03-21 (eu-west-1)
- Synthetic probe /v1/generate p95 latency: 210ms -> 340ms
- 429 rate: 0.8% -> 2.6% (since 3245679950)
- Affected shard: eu1-quant-pool

maya: seeing the same on dashboard, p95 jump on generate route, small error bump :thinking:
sam: can confirm, all canaries healthy but eu1 nodes that got model variant `redwood-model-v2-quant` show 429s
maya: is this likely queuing or model OOMs?
priya: looked at pod logs, not OOM, nginx upstream 502/429 from inference-proxy with `too_many_requests`
priya: sample probe output:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 1
{"error":"rate_limited","detail":"request queue full"}
```
alec: probably queue backpressure from longer token latencies + prefix miss spike
oncall-sre: noticed KV cache miss rate increased 3x around the same time, suggests cold cache warmup needed
maya: can we pin eu route to `redwood-model-v1` while we triage?
sam: +1, reduce customer impact
maya: /deploy pin-route --region eu-west-1 --route generate --model redwood-model-v1
deploy-bot: Executing: /deploy pin-route --region eu-west-1 --route generate --model redwood-model-v1
deploy-bot: Pin complete. Route `generate` in `eu-west-1` now pinned to `redwood-model-v1` (change id chg_3245679999)
priya: will kick a manual warmup script to prefill KV for eu1 and throttle synthetic probes to 10r/s for 3m
oncall-sre: also increasing per-pod concurrency from 4 -> 6 for the warmup window (monitoring p95)
maya: good. hold rollout of v2-quant in eu until 1h after warmup + validation
sam: adding a quick watch: probe frequency x5, will report back in 10m
maya: TY all, tag me on updates :thumbsup:
sam: quick note for release notes: rolled back routing in eu due to synthetic probe surge; follow-up action: KV warmup + concurrency tweak
deploy-bot: Watch configured: /synth watch generate eu-west-1 freq=5x duration=10m -> alerts to #eng-releases
sam: observed 429s drop to 0.6% after warmup (initial 30s)
maya: will re-evaluate at T+10m and decide whether to unpin
oncall-sre: logging incident for postmortem tracking: inc-3245680001
maya: ok leaving this thread open for the handoff
